create_HDBSCAN_clustering: create an HDBSCAN clusterer with configurable min_cluster_size and metric to fit on feature data
run_HDBSCAN_fit_predict: run HDBSCAN fit_predict on a feature array and return cluster labels with noise detection
build_single_linkage_tree_brute: build a single-linkage tree from raw data using brute-force MST computation
build_single_linkage_tree_prims: build a single-linkage tree from raw data using KDTree or BallTree nearest-neighbor search
test_dbscan_clustering: test the dbscan_clustering method to return flat clustering at a given cut_distance
summarize_remap_single_linkage_tree: summarize how remap_single_linkage_tree reindexes tree nodes for non-finite data points
review_tree_to_labels: review the tree_to_labels function that converts a single-linkage tree into cluster labels and probabilities
